onboarding1.title: Welcome to M’go Pass!
onboarding1.description:
🎉 Discover Morocco’s first all-in-one game pass!
With M’go Pass, you can enjoy top venues — from playgrounds to museums to surf classes — all with one smart membership.
Whether you're a family, a young explorer, or a tourist, M’go Pass makes fun easy and affordable.

onboarding2.title: How M’go Pass Works
onboarding2.description:
🎟️ 1. Choose your membership (Kids, Adult, or Tourist)
📍 2. Explore included venues nearby
📲 3. Show your QR pass at the venue to redeem
✅ 4. Enjoy the game — 100% cash-free and easy!

onboarding3.title: Smart Access, Real Savings
onboarding3.description:
💰 Save hundreds of dirhams with just a few visits
📆 You can use each venue once or twice per year
🕒 Partners set their valid times (like weekdays or mornings)
📍 Everything is managed digitally — no paper tickets!

onboarding4.title: Trusted by Top Venues
onboarding4.description:
🏅 Our partners are verified & approved
📸 You can preview every game before visiting
🔒 Your QR code is secure and unique
🎁 Some venues may offer special perks for members!

faq.question1: How long is my pass valid for?
faq.answer1: M'go Passes are valid 1 year from the date of purchase, not for a calendar year. If you purchase your pass in the middle of the year and events are past or out of season, they will be available to you the following season until your pass expires.
faq.question2: What happens when I renew my M'go Pass membership early?
faq.answer2: Renewing your M'go Pass membership early simply extends your original expiration date one year. Any visits to venues prior to your original pass expiring will count towards your original pass.  If it exceeds the allowed limit, it will count towards the renewed pass.  Once your original pass expires, your pass usages will reset to zero.
faq.question3: How do I reserve my tickets to a sporting event?
faq.answer3: The calandar icon on the M'go Pass app displays all upcoming 'Events' available to you as a M'go Pass member.  Choose the event to register your passes.  If your on www.M'gopass.com, click on the venue you would like to reserve tickets for and proceed to the 'Events' tab at the top of the page slideout. Event registration links appear next to that event 2 weeks prior to game day, and disappears 48 hours prior to event start. Tickets will either be at 'Will Call' the day of event, or will be emailed electronically depending on how the venue dispurses tickets.  Instructions for getting tickets will arrive in your event registration confirmation email.
faq.question4: How do I change my contact information for my M'go Pass?
faq.answer4: Simply login to your account and you will be able to edit your account information.
faq.answer5: M'go Pass memberships are not transferrable.  Each pass comes with the owner`s name and individualized bar code that can only be used by the pass owner.
faq.question6: Will the current Venues always be available on the M'go Pass?
faq.answer6: We anticipate that current venues will remain on the M'go Pass. However, participating venues are subject to change.  New venues are often added at no additional charge to current M'go Pass members.
faq.question7: At what age do I need M'go Pass?
faq.answer7: We recommend that children ages 2 years old and up have their own M'go Pass with their own name on it. Most venues begin charging admission at this age. Some venues do require admission for children who have had a birthday.  Please check specific venue pages for details.
faq.question8: Will any new Venues be added?
faq.answer8: Yes. We are always looking at adding additional venues to the M'go Pass. When done, existing pass holders are automatically included.
faq.answer9: M'go Pass will refund orders within 30 days of purchase.  Refunds will not be issued on memberships that have been used at participating venues.
